licence.title: Data & licences
licence.intro: Vestigia is built on data that others made freely reusable. Terms differ by layer — here is what applies to each.
licence.recordsBody: Site and tracing text is CC BY-SA — free to reuse and adapt, including commercially, provided changes are shared under the same licence and the source is credited. The structured metadata (coordinates, dates, categories) is CC0 — no rights reserved.
licence.imagesBody: Every photograph carries its own licence and attribution, shown beneath the image itself. Licences vary per record; check the image before reusing it separately from the site it illustrates.
licence.barringtonBody: Ancient coastline, roads, water and places are drawn from the Ancient World Mapping Center (ODbL 1.0) and Pleiades (CC BY 3.0). Both are reusable, including commercially, with attribution — ODbL's share-alike applies to the underlying database, not to the rendered map tiles.
licence.dareBody: This basemap is CC BY-SA 3.0 from Johan Åhlfeldt (Digital Atlas of the Roman Empire, Gothenburg University) — but two of its own source layers are credited non-commercial (CC BY-NC 3.0 / CC BY-NC-SA), which the blanket CC BY-SA cannot override. Treat this specific layer as non-commercial use only.
licence.limesBody: The frontier line is derived from the Ancient World Mapping Center's extent of the empire (ODbL 1.0) and is not part of the contributed database.
